overloadMerges.note: The doc syntax line has no parenthesized parameter list ('Select folder : Text'), so the mechanical parser produced an empty overload with no return type at all; restored the documented Text return type.
overloadMerges.semanticRole: Displays a dialog box (with no custom title or default location) that allows the user to manually select a folder, and returns the complete access path to that folder.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Displays a dialog box, with the given message and default location/options, that allows the user to manually select a folder, and returns the complete access path to that folder.

constraints: This command does not modify 4D's current folder.
defaultPath as a memorized-path number (1-32,000) lets 4D remember, per number, the last folder the user browsed to and reuse it as the default on subsequent calls.
